models.name: Zing
models.summary: Zing-0.5 is a 5B causal world model that keeps rolling a scene forward while keyboard actions and text prompts change it mid-stream. It starts from text or a single image, and the weights are Apache-2.0.
models.controls: W/A/S/D/I/J/K/L keys and text prompts during a rollout
